overview: After a tragedy destroys his life, a humble diner owner swallows the soul of the true king to gain extraordinary powers. With exactly one hundred days until his own soul is consumed, he embarks on a dangerous quest to defeat a tyrannical usurper, overthrow corrupt conglomerates, and help his host reclaim the throne.
title: Crowned in a Hundred Days

overview: An arrogant, brilliant teenager arrives at a prestigious Chinese restaurant in Tokyo to fulfill his grandfather's dying wish. Operating under the brutal philosophy that "cooking is a battle," he engages in high-stakes culinary duels, clashing with rival chefs who believe food should be made with heart and care.
title: Iron Wok Jan!

overview: The story follows Kodō Iwamoto, a third-year student at a military-controlled school. He is tasked with traveling across the countryside to investigate paranormal phenomena, track down people with uncanny supernatural abilities, and offer them letters of recommendation to join an elite, secretive military academy.
title: Recommendations from Iwamoto-Senpai

overview: A patriotic detective series about the challenging lives of spies in Russia, from the creators of *School 13 – Igroorgii*. Russian intelligence agents Ivan Smirnov, Sun-Dun Baldaev, and Roman Petskov save the world. Armed with natural resourcefulness and a ruthless knack for navigating conflict, they tackle impossible missions: overcoming the global crisis, ending famine in Africa, and resolving the Arab-Israeli conflict. Whether facing an anti-Russian Masonic order or a massive diamond-related catastrophe, the agents can defeat anything.
title: Разведчики

overview: Join ten little characters on big adventures, counting from 10-1 as they go. Get ready for action, hilarious surprises, silly rhymes and so much fun! Inspired by the beloved Ten Little picture book series by Mike Brownlow and Simon Rickerty.
title: Ten Little...Who?

overview: Bitzer the sheep dog is tasked with getting Timmy and his two best friends, Yabba and Apricot, to Mossy Bottom School safe and on time each morning! Like all excitable children Timmy and the gang are curious, full of energy, and every morning turns into a surrealist escapade as they veer off-course turning the school run into an adventure. Thankfully Bitzer, the long-suffering and faithful chaperone always manages to get to them to the school gates in the nick of time.
title: Let's Go Timmy!

overview: A late-night indie animated comedy showcase aboard a cartoon train to Toon World, with deranged shorts from cult-favorite creators.
title: Toon World Express

overview: High school student Jiwoo Seo knows nothing of the hidden world around him. Terrified of his own mysterious powers, he lives quietly, concealing his abilities from everyone. But everything changes the day he rescues a battered stray cat who turns out to be none other than Kayden—the most powerful Awakened being alive.
title: Eleceed

overview: "The seal will be broken after many years". In the land of Nospherus, four heroes embark on a patch of destiny that will weave a new legend. The story follows Guin, a powerful swordsman with a leopard head, the adolescent royal twins Remus and Rinda, and the young and ambitious mercenary named Istvan. The Guin Saga is an epic heroic fantasy in the same vein as Robert E. Howard's Conan, the Barbarian. More than a hundred manga books strong, Guin's saga has sold more than twenty-five million copies in Japan.
title: Guin Saga

overview: Gun Frontier is regarded as the start point of Leiji Matsumoto's 'World Ring'. It is a hilarious, thrilling and outrageous story that takes place on a lawless planet in deep space. In a wild land where the dust of sand swirls, two totally different men, Harlock 'the Quick Draw' and Tochiro 'the Master Swordsman', meet a mysterious woman called Sinunora and travel together. This odd threesome get involved in thrilling and outrageous brawls and seem to attract one fight after another! The planet is called "Gun Frontier". There is no law and order on this dry and barren star.
title: Gun Frontier

overview: In St. Mikhailov Academy, Oribe Mafuyu meets a silver-haired boy called Alexander. He is a Qwaser, a being who can manipulate iron and draws his power from breast milk. A mystery surrounding an Icon transforms the academy into the setting for conflict between the various different Qwaser.
title: Seikon no Qwaser

overview: Idaten Jump follows a young, passionate mountain biker named Sho Yamato who is mysteriously transported to the "X-Zone" alongside his friends and his custom bike, the Flame Kaiser. To return to their home world, the group must win high-stakes "Idaten Battles" against other riders across various treacherous environments.
title: Idaten Jump

overview: Yang Yu is a university upperclassman who's loved by everyone, and Huan Li is a quiet, antisocial new student. The two of them get off on the wrong foot, but despite clashing and repelling one another at times, they are still drawn to each other.
title: Here U Are

overview: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya loves listening to rock, but no one else seems to share her interest…until she meets a cool, stylish employee at a CD shop. Dressed in black from head to toe, he has this air of mystery about him, and his taste in music is impeccable. Aya falls hard for him—not knowing her crush is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! For her part, Mitsuki generally keeps to herself and avoids standing out at school. But given that she sits right next to Aya, Mitsuki's all too aware of the other girl's feelings, and she's afraid to reveal the truth. So why does she find herself talking with Aya more and more…?
title: The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn't a Guy at All

overview: Halo: The Fall of Reach is an animated adaptation of the beloved Eric Nylund novel of the same name, and in many ways the origin story of the Master Chief and Blue Team. Halo: The Fall of Reach tells the dramatic tale of the origin and intrigue behind the SPARTAN program that propelled characters like the Master Chief and Dr. Catherine Halsey into the pantheon of Halo lore. The story reveals the events that brought Master Chief and Blue Team together, including their Spartan training and their daring mission to strike back at the Covenant during the first days of the deadly alien invasion.
title: Halo: The Fall of Reach

overview: Burdened by crushing debt, omega Kim Euihyun struggles to protect his younger brother while searching for a way out of despair. His life changes after meeting the wealthy alpha Yeo Taeju, leading to a complicated relationship shaped by survival, trust, and love.
title: Low Tide in Twilight

overview: Follows Fred, an optimistic everyman trying to do the right thing who somehow creates absolute chaos for himself.
title: Fred Has Problems

overview: As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?
title: Saved by the Ice Cold Prince's Embrace

overview: Without warning in the year 2050, an alien race known only as the Inbit arrive, invade and successfully conquer the Earth. Years later and despite brutal past failures, the inhabitants of Mars Colony send out yet another desperate Liberation Force to try and reclaim their lost home world. The fleet is all but destroyed. However, a lone survivor, Stig Bernard, finds himself on Earth. Gathering a mere handful of resistance fighters, Stig journeys on towards the Inbit's headquarters at Reflex Point in an attempt to gather intelligence and, possibly, discover a way to beat them.
title: Genesis Climber Mospeada

overview: The series follows the misadventures of cut-rate mercenary monkey duo Shrike and Beebs as they cruise the galaxy in search of decent-paying contracts.
title: Monkey Wrench

overview: Atlas is determined to set off for the stars, but things take a wild turn when her attempt to steal a starship doesn't go as planned. After mysteriously getting tossed across universes, Atlas and Atmosphere have no choice but to team up together if they ever want to make it off of the strange dying planet, Quasonia.
title: Atlas and the Stars

overview: Two young boys… the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom – a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region. The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return. Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war. The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.
title: Suikoden: The Anime

overview: Sirotan anime series follows the daily exploits of the titular fluffy, white harp seal and his animal friends as they lead cozy, laid-back lives. Based on the popular Japanese character brand by Creative Yoko, the show focuses on simple, everyday adventures designed to spread comfort and healing.
title: Sirotan

overview: In a fantastical Wild West world, oddball Pearl West is the only one who thinks of mechs as anything more than tools and appliances. But one fateful day she stumbles upon an unlikely friend: a curious mech named Six who carries a tremendous secret. Now Pearl, aided by her stalwart brother and a quirky salesman named Casey, must brave the dangers of the untamed frontier to protect Six from dangerous bandits. The future of all the Western nations may very well rest in Pearl's hands!
title: MechWest

overview: The surreal daily lives of the employees of the Bigtop Burger food truck.
title: Bigtop Burger

overview: The story follows young Ming He, whose "junk superpower" mutates into a special entity called the "Dependent Spirit" after colliding with the "Goddess" meteorite, triggering a series of adventures and crises.
title: Chaofan Jinhua

overview: In a city experiencing a spiritual resurgence, demons threaten to invade. Qin Yu, a boy born with a useless spiritual root, unexpectedly awakens divine power within him and is chosen to inherit the mysterious and powerful cultivation technique, "The Life-Giving Power of All Things." After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .
title: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan

overview: Shelldon follows the adventures of Shelldon, a Yoka Star Shell, and his lively sea-creature friends on their underwater exploits. Set in the idyllic coral reef community called Shell Land, the inhabitants also include Shelldon's best friends, Herman, a Hermit crab and Connie, a Cowry shell, and a colorful array of sea characters.
title: Shelldon

overview: In the chaotic times, demons and monsters roam freely, and treacherous officials are in power. With the invasion of the Netherworld, both humans and Netherworld beings wreak havoc on the mortal world, and the wild gods who work for the Netherworld bully the common people. Enraged, Xu Ying, a snake-catcher, rebels and commits the sin of killing a god, and also takes out an incompetent court official. Hunted down by the two realms, his fleeing begins...
title: Zeri Feisheng

overview: Join Humble, Stumble, and Grumble as they work together to gather ingredients and prepare the most fantastic dishes from their Bumble Nums cookbook! Purple Pear Pie? Yum! Sparkling Strawberry Smoothies? Yum! Stretchy Spaghetti Surprise? Yum! Yay Bumble Nums!
title: The Bumble Nums

overview: For over half a century since their creation, cyborg warriors have protected humanity from various enemies that threaten peace. However, the battle continues... And now, a group of nine cyborgs known as "Nemesis" has emerged, believing that the 009s alone cannot bring peace to the world. Led by Graviton, a cyborg who can manipulate gravity, what is the ideal they are striving for? Are we witnessing a generational shift!?
title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis

overview: A young, spirited boy, Jing Tianming, carries a heroic bloodline and survives the chaotic rise of the Qin Dynasty. Fleeing the Emperor's tyranny alongside a master swordsman and other rebel warriors, he grows from a naive youth into a great hero whose exploits help shape the course of Chinese history.
title: Qin's Moon: The Legend of Qin

overview: Jun becomes the rightful owner of the amazing Metal Breath! Together with Blue Cop, they will discover all the Metal Cardbots!
title: Metal Cardbot

overview: The girl warrior Fania meets a young man with amnesia named Tutor, and the two embark on a journey together, gradually revealing the secret of the enemy - Alien. At the same time, it is also discovered that a certain mysterious force hides behind it and wants to control the life of the girl warrior Slude. They decided to rise up and purify the land...
title: THRUD

overview: In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.
title: GuAn

overview: Anatole is an imaginative, inventive, rebellious little guy. And when the schemes he puts in place turn against him and he catches himself in his own nets, there remains a beautiful loser, a magnificent loser. It is in his glorious defeats that he wins the friendship and respect of others, especially young viewers.
title: Anatole Latuile

overview: He was The Greatest Talent in the Nine Hells Realm. Shen Zhenyi began to practice his sword when he was four years and two months old. At the age of seven, he studied the Ten Thousand Sword Sutra. By the age of eleven, he fought against the Yudao in Shangqing Palace. In an instant, he unleashed one hundred and eighty-five sword strikes, making it impossible for anyone to retaliate. The Yudao admitted defeat and deemed him as "The Peerless Genius." At the age of 14, Shen Zhenyi, with his Six Forms of the Ancient Sword, surpassed the swordsman Zuo Tianxing who was ranked among the top ten masters in the world, and won the title of "The First Swordsman of the Abyss." He now lies crippled. A fraction of the state he was in before. Or so they thought.
title: Wangu Jian Shen

overview: Moley is a charming, optimistic young mole who lives deep in a burrow under Windsor Castle, in the hustling, bustling city of MoleTown. He is The Keeper of the Mystical Manual of Magic (or Manny as he likes to call him). The series follows the life of MoleTown's most famous mole.
title: Moley

overview: An environmentally unlivable environment on Earth following a catastrophic event has driven humans to live underground. They dispatched robots called Chumballs out to the surface to restore Earth. The Chumballs are supposed to beam a signal down to the humans once their work is complete and confirm that the surface can be resided again. But the humans haven't received the signal, forgot the Chumballs, and are forced by the council to remain inside the Earth. Three kids, Solana, Stel, and Tom, and their robot Tago, leave the underground and explore the surface of Earth on a goal to search and reactivate the Chumballs.
title: Les Chumballs

overview: Alice believes in magic. With all her heart, she believes that magic is possible and that it can be used for good deeds and fun games. But suddenly, she finds herself transported into another world, ruled by a mysterious elite of witches - and these witches don't seem to be in it for the fun. They're hard at work capturing sprites, the native magical beings of the world, and forcing them into slavery. Once Alice realizes that her new surroundings aren't just a dream, she sets out to change things.
title: Mahou Shoujo-tai Arusu

overview: After a defeat in a major competition, Zhang Ruoyu is forced to leave her professional career and return to campus. In an unfamiliar environment, table tennis (Ping-Pong), which once plunged her into darkness, becomes a light that pierces through her confusion. At the ping-pong table, she meets her teammates; outside the court, she fosters friendships. This time, the young woman decides to use all her strength to strike towards the future.
title: White Lightning

overview: Zhao Hezhou's mother, in order to save her arrogant and domineering eldest daughter Zhao Xin'er, activated her innate gift — the "Primordial Chaos Physique" — while heavily pregnant, pulling her gravely wounded daughter back from the brink of death. But that single act came at a devastating cost: the unborn Zhao Hezhou had his very foundation destroyed, and he came into the world branded as a cripple.
title: Cast Out by My Family, I Awakened 900 Million Stat Points

overview: In CoComelon Playdates with Sanrio Friends, the worlds of CoComelon and Sanrio collide in the most playful way! This adorable 2D animated series brings JJ and his friends together with Hello Kitty, Pompompurin, and other beloved Sanrio pals for whimsical sing-alongs, silly adventures, and heart-warming moments of friendship in JJ's imaginative world. Centered around a cozy Clubhouse, the series features a special design created by Sanrio, blending CoComelon's joyful, music-driven storytelling with Sanrio's iconic "cute" aesthetic. Each 3-minute episode celebrates cooperation, curiosity, and playful learning, featuring reimagined nursery rhymes and beloved Japanese children's songs that inspire movement and early language development.
title: CoComelon Playdates with Sanrio Friends

overview: The series is set in the near future, when an automobile company named JHC Motors is depicted to have created the Watch Cars, which are miniature sentient robotic cars that are supposed to have become good companions to children and adults alike. Watch Cars are depicted to have become a global trend. There is a Battle League where Watch Cars and their trainers battle. Jino, one of the young Watch Car Masters, goes to the Watch Car Battle League with his Watch Car Blue-will, but The Rangers of Darkness an evil force to takeover al the watch cars in The city, Jino and his friends must stop them.
title: Pawobaeteul Wachika

overview: In a world of cats, Splat, an adorable 6-year-old cat, experiences countless adventures in the company of his best friend, Harry, a mouse.
title: Splat et Harry

overview: A preschool television series which combines puppetry and animatronics, Wumpa's World takes you on an adventurous ride that will open the eyes and hearts of children everywhere. Wumpa the Walrus and his wacky companions Ziggy, Zag, Tiguak, Seeka and Tuk explore the magical, whimsical world of the Great North.
title: Wumpa's World

overview: Once hailed as the third-strongest expert on the Tianwu Continent, Martial Emperor Gu Feiyang found his cultivation trapped at its peak by the very laws of the world. To break through his limits, he orchestrated an audacious plan, sacrificing everything to reincarnate and begin anew. Reborn as Li Yunxiao, a fifteen-year-old heir of a powerful military family in the Kingdom of Tianshui, he finds himself caught in a storm of invasion, royal succession struggles, and political intrigue. While others fight for power and status, Li Yunxiao sees the bigger picture. Armed with the wisdom and experience of a former Martial Emperor, he calmly overcomes every obstacle on his path toward a single goal: completing the grand design he began in his previous life and laying the foundation for true godhood.
title: The Eternal Supreme, Li Yunxiao

overview: Each episode of Disney's Play Break invites YOU to be part of the story as you get up and get active in these fun-filled brain break activities.
title: Disney Jr. Play Break!

overview: Anime shorts that offer a secret candid look at the daily lives of Monster Musume. These 30 second shorts aired daily (except on weekends) and were available for 24 hours only. Later, they were all included as extras on a blu-ray disc release.
title: Monster Musume no Iru Nichijou: Hobo Mainichi ◯◯! Namappoi Douga

overview: Upon waking up, Subaru Natsuki finds himself in a parallel reality of the fantasy world he has come to accept as his own. Despite being familiar faces, Subaru's friends are vastly different, especially as they enjoy the life of modern society that he knows all too well. This mysterious world captures the intrepid boy's interest nonetheless, and a clash between his antics and the dubious inhabitants soon leads to all sorts of amusing scenarios.
title: Re:Petit - Re:Petit kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu

overview: Spiff, Hercules and Pifi humorously expose harmful behaviors to the planet and encourage young people to change their consumption habits.
title: Pif et Hercule se mettent au vert

overview: Welcome to Doll World! A beautiful place where all dolls live and play in harmony with a shared goal of inspiring future generations of girls to dream big and be anything!
title: Barbie Doll Adventures

overview: Welcome to CAMP CRUSH! The most epic summer camp ever! Your favorite Monster Trucks will face off in a crash course to be the best and earn DESTRUCTION BADGES! The Trucks with the most badges by the end of Camp Crush will qualify to compete in the Champion's Cup! So pack your bags and get ready for #CAMPCRUSH!
title: Hot Wheels: Monster Trucks Camp Crush

overview: A series of animated streaming television specials based on both the Lego Disney toyline and Disney Princess franchise.
title: Lego Disney Princess

overview: The series follows the adventures of Randalf the wizard and his human apprentice Newt as they attempt to thwart the devious attempts of Dr Cuddles, an evil blue teddy bear, from taking over the land.
title: Muddle Earth

overview: New anime with combined title that continues the story of BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! and BanG Dream! Ave Mujica.
title: BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! / Ave Mujica

overview: Panda and Krash follows the adventures of an impulsive little Rabbit and a loyal Panda.
title: Панда и Крош

overview: When college student Uyun meets the quiet and introverted TA Jinhyeong, he immediately asks him out, saying he wants to get to know him more. After just three days of dating, Jinhyeong moves in with him, and that's when he starts showing a completely different wild side. All of his BL novel and comic consumption has perverted his perception of the perfect first time with his boyfriend. He's thought of it all, from doing it in the subway to having Uyun role-play as a K-pop idol. But as weird as Jinhyeong's ideas are, Uyun doesn't entirely hate it...?
title: One-Room TA

overview: Akihito is a college student obsessed with good looks and carnal pleasure, but he can't stand the handsome-yet-aloof Sae. Things come to a head when Akihito is shot down at a singles mixer by a girl who's set her romantic sights on Sae. Furious, he follows Sae to the hotel district where he learns Sae's secret: he's gay, and he's having trouble enjoying himself in the bedroom. Breaking through Sae's mental barriers is exactly the sexy challenge Akihito needed. It awakens something in them both. Will they ever be able to control themselves again?
title: Perfect Addiction

overview: Seo-woo reunites with Ra-on, the crush from his school days. Because of his shy nature, he asks his twin brother, Jae-woo, to step in and flirt on his behalf. However, Jae-woo—who initially had no interest—finds himself falling for Ra-on before he knows it... A sizzling love triangle born from a sweet, unrequited crush. Who will ultimately win Ra-on's heart?
title: Seeing Double

overview: The documentary-animated series "Scientist Ladies" is dedicated to eight disciplines: mathematics, chemistry, biology, physics, meteorology, geology, microbiology, and astronomy. Each episode tells the story of outstanding women scientists of the 19th and 20th centuries who achieved academic success despite limited access to education, stereotypes, and public opinion. How did their achievements influence the development of various fields of knowledge, and which contemporary women scientists are advanced science today? The voice of the project is actress Irina Gorbacheva.
title: Учёные дамы

overview: Join Thomas, Percy, Rosie and all their friends as they work together and form lasting bonds that help them overcome any obstacle.
title: Thomas & Friends: Railway Stories

overview: Kanna, a second-year middle school student aspiring to be an idol, goes to the paleontology club to complain about noise. There, she is forcibly challenged to a quiz competition by Tetori, a paleontology enthusiast, with her club membership as the stake! Did Tyrannosaurus Rex stand upright like that monster? Or did it have feathers? What are the secrets of dinosaurs whose appearance changed over time?!
title: Plannosaurus: Serious Paleontology Club

overview: "What if cats appeared in those stories...?" When cats are added to famous folktales and fairy tales, a heartwarming and surreal new development unfolds...!? Tabby, orange tabby, calico, white cat, and many other kinds of cats x folktales - guaranteed to soothe all of humanity! An adorable cat comedy begins!
title: Cat Tales

overview: In a bakery late at night, when everyone is asleep, bread dough, affectionately known as "baby bread," rests quietly in the refrigerator . But secretly, they wake up and gather together to chat, clean , and even fight. Or, during the day, they bask in the sun on the roof. Because they are still "dough" before being baked, they can change and have endless possibilities. This is the everyday adventure of these ignorant, timid, and sometimes brave baby breads .
title: Babies of Bread

overview: Koala writes about daily life, whether it's good or bad, happy or sad. Koala treats every day as a precious day.
title: Koala's Diary

overview: The stories that lie within the cards come to life...
title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Game The Chronicles

overview: Basketball, Baseball, Soccer... When it comes to handling a ball, Cha Youngwoong, a fifth-grade elementary school student, exhibits overwhelming abilities. One day, while cleaning out the warehouse at the request of his mother, he discovers a mysterious marble. At that moment, the villain duo "Team MABORI" and the monster creature 'Pachyla' appear to break the warehouse and threaten the hero, but With the help of the Mechanimal 'Akan' hidden in the warehouse, he uses a mysterious orb - 'Mecard Ball' to succeed in defeating them. After that, Cha Youngwoong hears a surprising story from Akan... Mechanimals living with ball energy that have existed on Earth for a long time. Cha Youngwoong's ability to handle a ball freely is said to be related to his mother. He is determined to find the lost memories of his mother and protect the peace of the earth. Mysterious characters appear one after another in front of Cha Youngwoong who begins to collect Mecard Balls and Mechanimals, and a battle unfolds. From the mysterious girl Sera to Kirayan who threatens the earth. Will he be able to regain his mother's memory and protect the peace of the earth with Akan?
title: Mecard Ball

overview: After his parents are killed in an accident, Teppei Kobayashi is adopted by his grandfather, Isshin Arima. After taking his grandfather's name, Teppei is made the heir to the Arima Financial Combine, one of the leading forces in the Japanese industry. As befits the heir to an industrial empire, he is enrolled in one of Japan's most prestigious international schools. There, Teppei finds himself surrounded by women of noble bearing and status. He quickly falls for Sylvia van Hossen, a European princess and fencing master. But Sylvia is aloof and difficult to read, and his maid, Yuu Fujikura, seems to have her own agenda. Will Teppei become the Princess Lover, or is his romance with Sylvia destined for failure? Unlike TV anime with the same title, this two-part OVA sub-series feature adult content.
title: Princess Lover!

overview: The game has crossed into reality, and the old rules no longer apply. Humanity enters an age where anyone can awaken a class, but the opportunity draws unwanted attention: demons from the abyss and the dragonkin both want this new world, and neither is willing to share it. Lin Moyu wakes up in this world with the one class no one else has: Necromancer. His talent is unmatched, his ability system unlike anything else in play, and he grows stronger with every fight, building an army out of the dead until he no longer needs anyone else at his side. As the Shenxia Empire's last line of defense against the abyssal invasion, he becomes the one man capable of breaking the deadlock between humans, demons, and dragons, and the one who ends up standing above all three.
title: The Necromancer! I Am A Disaster

overview: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Lola Bunny, Tweety... so many friends are all here! This Gokko (or "pretend play") series has all your favorite Looney Tunes characters like you've never seen them before!
title: Looney Tunes Gokko

overview: The legendary bishoujo game "Magical★Explorer" I was reincarnated not as the protagonist surrounded by heroines thanks to my cheat abilities, but as Takine Kousuke, the unfortunate friend character who just puts on a forced smile beside them ...! In the original game, he's inconspicuous, unrewarded, and remains a supporting character until the very end. But I have the knowledge from my past life, having played this game to its fullest extent! Furthermore, this friend character has a hidden ability: "the world's highest magical power," potentially surpassing even the protagonist...? In order to lead the heroines he has longed for and met in this world to happy endings, his friend Kousuke fights his way through this world!
title: Magical Explorer

overview: Ame is a child who loves sweets. Living inside her mouth is a cavity named Caries! Caries calls Ame "Mom," turns teeth into furniture, and even hijacks her body. Ame is always being pushed around by this free-spirited cavity. "I'm not your Mom!" Ame cries. "Yes you are! You gave me a room and feed me sweets," retorts Caries. Enjoy this slapstick comedy about a slightly strange parent-child pair!
title: Candy Caries

overview: Here's my classmates Uta Aihara, Moripura-kun, and friends, who shared joys and sorrows with me during my trainee days, so please do check it out!! A natural, heart-fluttering youth story... but there are intriguing elements everywhere!
title: The Lenticulars

overview: Everyone's favorite ninja turtles, Leo, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey, are back! Set in their childhood years, this original series explores the early days of the iconic ninja turtles on their first adventures as ninjas-in-training. They'll even be joined by their friend April O'Neil, and encounter foes like Bebop, Rocksteady, and Karai.
title: Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles

overview: In the vast land of China, the gods who were in charge of the laws of heaven and earth died and lost their legal boundaries. The forces of darkness will move, trying to overthrow the entire land. Ning Chen was an ordinary guard in the Canglan palace. He gained the power of swallowing spirits by accident and increased his cultivation level. Initially, he was able to compensate for this. However, the crisis began . First, the royal cronies betray each other. The imperial leaders turned to each other. In the face of many hardships, Ning Chen adhered to the principle of doing things as much as his ability and responsibility, bravely raised leaders, and faced hardships together Hua Wanyue and others people , and solve crisis after crisis. However, the enemy's perilous and intertwined scheme, Ning Chen and the others gradually discovered that there was a bigger conspiracy waiting for them.
title: I Am The Only God

overview: A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects.
title: Gekkan! Nanmono Anime

overview: The story takes place in Tokyo in 2018, where normal humans and those who can use magic coexist. As a result, there are laws against using magic, and a "magic courtroom" exists to preside over lawsuits regarding magic use. In these cases, "Benmashi" or wizard barristers defend those who use magic. The anime follows Cecil, the youngest Benmashi in history, and her associates as they defend clients in these cases.
title: Wizard Barristers: Benmashi Cecil

overview: College student Kurumi Fukuga finally makes her long-awaited debut in FX (foreign exchange margin trading). Her reason? To recoup the 20 million yen her late mother lost in FX. "I'll easily get 20 million yen back!" she vows, but the world she plunges into is one where heaven or hell can be turned upside down in an instant. Unrealized losses, stop-loss orders, a heart that won't stop beating... Yet she still wants to buy, sell, and make money! With the addition of Yasuko and other eccentric FX warriors, the market heats up even more! A cute yet slightly (!!) dangerous money game where they fluctuate between joy and sorrow over the charts. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world ?!
title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan

overview: Strawberry's cozy neighborhood bakery is officially open, and her Berry Besties are always popping by. Sometimes they're lending a helping hand, sometimes they're hungry customers and sometimes they're just swinging by for a snack and some fun together. Whether she's whipping up desserts in her homey kitchen and bake shop, hosting friends in her snug upstairs apartment or throwing a sunshiney garden party out front, Strawberry brings the sweet warmth of a baked treat into every moment … and she's always ready for whatever friend stops by next.
title: Strawberry Shortcake's Bake Shop

overview: The anime "Dragon Ball, " with original story, character designs, and concept by Akira Toriyama, is relaunched as "Dragon Ball Beerus"! This version is "enhanced," featuring a significant number of new cuts, redrawn scenes, and a restructured storyline. With the latest visual effects, this enhanced version boasts even greater realism in battle scenes and a more precise reproduction of the original manga. Several years had passed since the fierce battle with Majin Buu, and Earth had regained a brief period of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakened from his long slumber. Even the Kais and Supreme Kais watched with awe as Beerus, possessing overwhelming power capable of destroying stars, awakened... But then, having heard rumors of a Saiyan who had defeated Frieza, Beerus suddenly appeared before Goku.. With Beerus, possessing unprecedented power, arriving, Earth faces the threat of annihilation... A super-intense battle that will shake the universe begins between the God of Destruction and Goku and his friends..
title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus

overview: Kawakami City is famous for its strong dedication to its samurai ancestors. A healthy fighting spirit is always valued and it's even an important factor for success at school. Yamato, a second year student from Kawakami Highchool is always with his close friends (4 boys and 3 girls). They have all known each other since they were young and have done many things together. While they have many other friends, this group of seven is a close-knit, inseparable group. They even have a secret base where they meet. With the new semester, they welcome two girls into their group and shortly after things begin to change...
title: Maji de Watashi ni Koi Shinasai

overview: Wait Till Your Father Gets Home is an adult animated sitcom produced by Hanna-Barbera that aired in first-run syndication in the United States from 1972 to 1974 (airing on most NBC stations on Sunday nights at 10:30, except for the ones who had moved their late-night news to that slot). The show originated in a one-time segment on Love, American Style called "Love and the Old-Fashioned Father." The same pilot was later produced with a live cast (starring Van Johnson), but with no success. The show was the first primetime animated sitcom to run for more than a single season since The Flintstones more than ten years earlier and would be the only one until The Simpsons fifteen years later. The show was inspired by All in the Family.
title: Wait Till Your Father Gets Home

overview: The "dream railway paradise entertainment" story is set in a parallel world where Japan did not privatize its national railways. Naohito Takayama is an ordinary high school boy who dreams of a comfortable future working for the top-rated Japanese National Railways. He is assigned as a trainee in the Railways Security Force full of odd characters such as Sakurai, a troublemaker who hates men. On top of that, an extremist group called "RJ" plots to privatize the Japanese National Railways.
title: Rail Wars!

overview: In a world plagued by creatures known as Kaiju, Kafka Hibino aspired to enlist in The Defense Force. He makes a promise to enlist with his childhood friend, Mina Ashiro. Soon, life takes them in separate ways. While employed cleaning up after Kaiju battles, Kafka meets Reno Ichikawa. Reno's determination to join The Defense Force reawakens Kafka's promise to join Mina and protect humanity.
title: Kaiju No. 8: Narumi's Week at Work

overview: Sakura Ichiko is a 16-year-old girl who leads a charmed life and is blessed with beauty, brains, and health. She has an abundance of "Happiness Energy", which can make people happy, but at the cost of absorbing all the Happiness Energy from her surroundings. She has caused the energy balance of the world to become unbalanced and because of this, she becomes the target of a Poverty God named Momiji. Momiji's goal is to remove Ichiko's power of absorbing other people's Happiness Energy and to return all the energy she has taken to its rightful place.
title: Binbougami ga!

overview: Sidika is the story of Saka family and their young daughter Sidika who live in a poor neighborhood of Istanbul. Sidika was not allowed to go to high school, raised to wait her husband-to-be at her fathers home, not even allowed to leave their house on her own. But she educated herself through books, newspapers and TV. She approaches her life, half-witted older brother, oppressive and alcoholic father and traditionalist mother in a satirical and fun manner along with the current political and sociological events of Turkey and the world. She gazes the world through her window as she hungers for all the intellectual accumulation of the universe.
title: Sidika

overview: Mutta's life has hit rock bottom. He's been fired, blackballed from his profession and now he's had to move back in with his parents. Meanwhile, his kid brother Hibito has been literally riding a rocket and training to be an astronaut. The same career Mutta once dreamed of. So, is it ever too late to go after your dreams? Through a little coercing and a bit of covert activity, Mutta's family and friends can get his resume on the right desk, but from that point on it will be up to Mutta himself. Does he have what it takes to turn his life around and put his footprint on the moon? The first step on the highway to the stars is always the hardest, and in a job where crash and burn isn't just a euphemism, it will be the biggest risk Mutta's ever taken. But with the best support team ever, maybe he'll find what he needs to rekindle the spark inside him and light the biggest candle of them all!
title: Uchuu Kyoudai

overview: The card incarnations—the jacks and kings of the four suits—are confronted by a mystical force that reaches deep into their hearts. This force is the Joker, a mysterious and powerful card. Five animated stories await you: "Exchange," "The Knight of the Lucky Banner," "Ceiling," "All Inclusive," and "Endless." They appear completely different and disconnected (even executed in different artistic styles), but this is only at first glance... The characters of the "13 Cards" series are revealed in a new light. A more tragic and, most importantly, more personal side.
title: 13 Карт: Джокер представляет

overview: Pablo has started school. It's wild. It's wonderful. It's next level. From baffling rules to chaotic corridors, Pablo tackles it with imagination and help from his book animal friends.
title: Pablo: Next Level

overview: The Heroic Quest Of The Valiant Prince Ivandoe follows Ivandoe, a young prince of the forest who has been sent on an epic quest by his father – The Mighty Stag to retrieve the magical Golden Feather from the Eagle King. Ivandoe is accompanied by his squire, a small bird named Bert, together they get into all kinds of silliness during their adventure while discovering new areas of the forest and encounter strange creatures on their journey.
title: The Heroic Quest of the Valiant Prince Ivandoe

overview: A warrior from the Mahabharata who is born to Kunti and the Sun God Surya but raised in a charioteer's household. He possesses the gift of bow mastery that rivals the greatest warriors of his age, compelling him to enter a grand tournament usually reserved only for kings and princes, altering the course of an empire forever.
title: The Legend of Karna

overview: A massive "academy city" located in western Tokyo. In this city, with a total population of 2.3 million, approximately 80% of whom are students, a special curriculum for developing psychic abilities is implemented, and the students' abilities are evaluated on a six-level scale from "Level 0" to "Level 5". Boasting scientific and technological advancements far surpassing common sense, this dreamlike educational institution provides everyone with scientific abilities and allows them to live in peace—but behind this tranquility lies a "dark side" organization that undertakes dirty work that is never revealed to the public. "ITEM" - an elite unit composed of four girls. Kinuhata Saiai, who can freely manipulate nitrogen to provide an impenetrable defense. Frenda Seivelun, who uses explosives and traps to toy with the battlefield . Takitsubo Rikou, who can read and track the faint powers emitted by ability users. And Mugino Shizuri, one of only seven "Level 5" in Academy City. Then, a fifth girl appears before them. Their encounter with her leads the "items" into a new darkness. This is a story depicting the daily lives, bonds, and deep, profound darkness of girls with rather unusual abilities, steeped in violence, cruelty, and depravity.
title: A Certain Dark Side's Item

overview: The story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by the demon race, who is ordered by his master to leave the Black and White Mountain to kill three enemies who destroyed the demon race. In the process of investigating the truth, he gradually uncovers the story of the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and the mystery of his own destiny.
title: Raised by Demons: Panda Li
